outcome.description: How it ended, in plain words.

link.description: Dashboard route to what it made.

problem.description: Why it could not be put in the cut (the audio is kept).

videoId.description: The site's ID for the video (YouTube video ID, TikTok video ID, X post or media ID).

handle.description: The account's handle with its @ (YouTube @handle, TikTok @name, X @name).

command.description: The exact command Claude asked to run (raw view only).

op.description: The operation the dashboard runs when the person confirms.

humanOnly.description: A decision only people make (e.g. approving a cut).

proposal.description: The conversation's plan this card applies (t<turn>/<file>); the dashboard shows this card instead of a second plan card.

rationale.description: Why Claude proposes the change (from the plan).

unavailable.description: Why the dashboard cannot do this one.

byId.description: Who decided it (absent on cards decided by older versions and on safe steps that started by themselves).

note.description: What the person said should change (Not quite).

link.description: Dashboard route to what the action produced.

forId.description: Who it is for: the person whose message Claude was answering when it asked (anyone in the conversation may decide it).

review.description: Dashboard route to review what the card decides about (before deciding).

setUp.description: What this computer sets up first when the card runs (studio: studio quality, a one-time download of about 1.8 GB).

image.description: A picture of it (same-origin media URL).

frames.description: Pictures to look at before deciding (a motion graphic's test frames).

preview.description: A short preview video (same-origin media URL).

auto.description: It started by itself (a safe step, under the person's setting).

autoMode.description: It started by itself because Auto is on for the person it is for (a change that can be undone).

autoPriced.description: It uses a paid outside service and started by itself: Auto is on and estimates are off for the person it is for (within budgets and limits).

spendsIn.description: The project whose budget it spends from.

autoWaits.description: Why Auto didn't start this change that costs money by itself: a budget or daily limit nobody set.

savesVersion.description: It saves a new version of the cut (the card offers Save and render a review copy).

recipe.description: Recipes: a run's plan with its steps, what saving a cut would vary and keep, or what a draft or a version made current changes.

state.description: For kind=turn_end: the turn's final state; for kind=turn: note when it is a dashboard update.

user.description: For kind=turn: who sent it (their name).

userId.description: For kind=turn: who sent it (absent on older messages: the person who started the conversation).

count.description: For kind=proposals: how many proposal files this turn wrote.

actionId.description: For kind=action: the action card (see Conversation.actions).

reason.description: Why the assistant is unavailable (shown to the person).

loggedIn.description: Claude Code sign-in state; absent when Claude Code cannot report it.

authMethod.description: How Claude Code authenticates (e.g. claude.ai subscription or an API key).

billing.description: plan: a Claude subscription sign-in (usage counts toward the plan's limits; dollar figures are API-equivalent estimates); api: an API key or cloud provider (billed per token).

billingLabel.description: One line describing the billing mode.

budgetUsd.description: Default dollar cap per conversation with an API key (assistant.maxBudgetUsd); 0 on a Claude plan.

tokenLimitMillions.description: Default limit per conversation in millions of tokens.

planUsage.description: The Claude plan's own usage as Claude Code last reported it (plan sign-in only).

idleMinutes.description: An idle Claude Code process is ended after this long; the conversation resumes on the next message.

machine.description: This installation's name (conversations can be continued only on the machine that holds them).

live.description: Claude Code processes this daemon holds right now.

waiting.description: Cards and questions waiting for the person asking, in their conversations on this machine.

working.description: Conversations with a turn running on this machine.

activeRunId.description: The first conversation in working (kept for older dashboards).

notes.description: A person's notes about this sound (kept with the cut; not heard in the video).

fit.description: auto: starts with the video and ends with it (smooth fade; a longer track ends on a beat near the end when it has one, a shorter one fades out early or loops); manual (default): exactly in → out from at.

loop.description: fit auto: repeat a shorter track until the video ends.

ending.description: fit auto: where it ends near the video's end. phrase: where the music starts its next phrase (else its next bar, else a beat); beat: on a beat. Absent: on a beat (music added before phrases were found).

duck.description: true: gets quieter while someone talks (by duckDb or the mix's depths); false: never; absent: as the mix decides.

here.description: This browser is on the computer MetaRush runs on.

secure.description: The connection is private enough to type a password (this computer

delivery.description: How to say it (warm, slower, smiling): shown to whoever records and sent to TTS as context, never spoken.

fontFile.description: A font from the cut's resources (its short name); used instead of font.

logo.description: The brand's main logo (a resource name, usually logo): a graphic showing it shows the logo made for its background instead when the cut has one.

logoDark.description: The logo for dark backgrounds (a resource name, usually logo-dark).

logoLight.description: The logo for light backgrounds (a resource name, usually logo-light).

style.description: The look: clean, emphasis (the spoken word lights up), boxed, bold (big capitals for phones), highlight (a box follows the spoken word) or subtitle (plain subtitles).

size.description: How large the words are: small, medium (the default) or large.

source.description: transcript or dialogue = the clips' transcripts (default); voiceover = the narration (take word timings or the script); both = dialogue and narration; manual = segments.

showSpeakers.description: Show who is speaking above each caption line.

email.description: The account Claude Code is signed in to, when it says.

planName.description: The plan in words: Claude Max, an Anthropic API key.

at.description: When it was seen (a conversation: its latest message).

assetId.description: An asset ID, cut:<projectId>/<revisionId> for a cut from another project (nested, pinned to that version), or conv:<name> for a conversation the cut pins (its in and out are then seconds on the conversation's clock).

volume.description: Linear gain for the clip's own audio (1 = unchanged).

notes.description: A person's notes about this clip (kept with the cut; not shown in the video).

shots.description: A conversation clip's picture over time: one person, a layout, a text card or other footage, each until the next.

mutedMembers.description: A conversation clip: members whose sound is left out of this clip.

installationName.description: The machine that holds the Claude Code session (the only one that can continue it).

legacy.description: A single request from before conversations (read-only).

sessionLost.description: Claude Code no longer has this session on its machine (it cannot be resumed).

pendingActions.description: Cards and question cards waiting for a person.

watching.description: Cards whose work (a render, a snapshot, an import, a check) is still running; Claude hears when each finishes.

budgetUsd.description: Dollar cap with an API-key sign-in (0: none, a Claude plan).

costUsd.description: Claude Code's API-price estimate (real spend only with an API key).

tokenLimitMillions.description: The conversation's own limit in millions of tokens (absent: the installation default).

limitTokens.description: The limit that applies, in tokens.

metarushVersion.description: The MetaRush version its latest message ran on (Claude hears what's new after an update).

model.description: Model override (claude --model); empty means the installation default.

effort.description: Effort override (claude --effort); empty means the installation default.

contextTokens.description: Tokens in Claude's context after the latest reply.

compacted.description: Older tool rows were dropped to keep the stored transcript small (the full stream stays on the owning machine).

systemPrompt.description: The rules appended to Claude Code's system prompt (raw view only).

waitingFor.description: Who the cards and questions waiting are for: each is for the person whose message Claude was answering.

actions.description: Changes Claude asked for that a person runs or dismisses.

here.description: This machine holds the session (it can be continued here).

live.description: A Claude Code process is running for it on this machine.

resumable.description: It can take more messages (on the machine that holds it).

waitingForYou.description: Cards and questions waiting for the person asking: the ones Claude raised answering their messages.

mode.description: speaking: each track gets quieter while its person isn't speaking (less echo and bleed when nobody wore headphones); off: every track plays at its level throughout.

name.description: The person's name (name tags, captions; per-person sound settings find them by it).

use.description: both: picture and sound of one person (default); sound: one person's audio; picture: a shared picture such as a gallery view (its sound is not mixed).

start.description: Where the recording starts on the conversation's clock (seconds; negative when it started earlier).

drift.description: Clock drift in parts per million: recording time = (t − start) × (1 + drift/10⁶).

tag.description: The name tag's second line (a role, from People's notes).

framing.description: How this person's picture is framed (fill or fit, faces, focus, zoom).

nameTags.description: Name tags in layouts: on (default) or off.

sampleAligned.description: Each recording plays exactly where its start says, to the sample (new cuts). Absent: from the cut's next frame, as cuts made before it rendered.

layoutStyle.description: How its picture-in-picture and side-by-side layouts look (from the layout pack). Absent: as they always looked.

usd.description: The estimate in US dollars (to a tenth of a cent; About says a smaller one as less than a cent).

about.description: The estimate in words: about $0.40, less than a cent, nothing (made before).

parts.description: What it draws on, part by part.

notes.description: What to know about the estimate, in plain words.

step.description: The step it belongs to, when the estimate covers several (a run of several steps).

service.description: The outside service: ElevenLabs, Google Gemini.

what.description: What it makes: the AI voice, a generated shot, a clearer voice.

source.description: What it draws on: the clip, the script line, the picture.

unit.description: What is counted: credits, seconds of video, tokens.

units.description: The units in words: 86 characters (as many credits).

rate.description: The price it uses, with its date: $0.08 per 1,000 credits (ElevenLabs' prices of 23 Oct 2026).

usd.description: This part's estimate in US dollars (to a millionth: a few tokens cost less than a cent, not nothing).

free.description: Made before with the same settings: nothing is charged.

limits.description: Whose spending limits cover it, when not the service's own: AI services (generated video's budget and daily limit).

noChanges.description: The sheet is the same cut as its base revision.

headMoved.description: Someone saved a newer revision since this sheet's base.

rebased.description: Saving will combine these changes with the newer revision.

changes.description: What changes compared with the base (in plain words).

plan.description: The edit plan this sheet becomes.

address.description: Sent once, never returned: kept in this computer's keychain.

words.description: The database in words: the database on this computer, MongoDB Atlas (cluster0.example.mongodb.net), a MongoDB server on your network.

enabled.description: Automatic ducking (default on whenever the cut has a voiceover or a mix section).

sourceUnderVoiceoverDb.description: Clip audio while narration plays (default -18 dB).

musicUnderDialogueDb.description: Music under on-camera speech (default -12 dB; a track's own duckDb overrides it).

attack.description: Seconds the level ramps down before speech starts (default 0.25).

release.description: Seconds the level ramps back up after speech (default 0.5).

where.description: Inbox or the project names it is in.

mode.description: clean: on this machine, fast (less hiss and echo, softer harsh s sounds, clearer tone); studio: on this machine, slower and stronger (optional component); cloud: ElevenLabs voice isolation (paid).

strength.description: How much of the processed voice is heard (0–1; default 1: all of it).

off.description: Play the original voice (the settings and the processed copy are kept).

start.description: Where in the recording the copy starts (whole seconds).

variant.description: The processed copy (an audio asset with the recording's timing from start).

settings.description: The voice settings it was made with (who, how, how strongly)

ref.description: ID of a transcript segment or insight.

formatName.description: The format in words (OpenTimelineIO, FCPXML 1.8, Final Cut Pro 7 XML).

app.description: The editing app this format is for.

alsoOpens.description: Other editing apps that open it.

captions.description: The .srt file with the captions, when the cut has captions.

name.description: The browser the extension runs in (Chrome, Brave, Edge…).

method.description: browser = the file the page plays, fetched with the person's sign-in; recording = recorded while it played.

id.description: The person's line this fits (its ID).

original.description: The person's words for the line

text.description: Claude's words for the line (the same words when only the timing changes).

anchor.description: Where Claude starts the line (none: it follows the previous line).

kept.description: The person kept their own line here (Claude's change turned down).

sha256.description: The fixed copy: the SHA-256 of its file.

projectId.description: The project the folder belongs to (empty: the workspace library).

auto.description: faces: keep the main face in frame (from the clip's on-screen index); follow: move the crop with the subject as it moves.

focusX.description: Horizontal focal point kept in frame when cropping (0 left … 1 right).

path.description: Slash-separated path relative to the root.

status.description: deduped = the same bytes were already stored (same file again or kept as an alias); duplicate = identical to an existing asset under another name and skipped.

pip.description: Picture in picture: where the inset sits, its size, shape and frame.

sideBySide.description: Side by side (and stacked): the gap, frame and what shows between the pictures.

waiting.description: Large files that upload when a cut first uses them.

pending.description: Files still being copied in (they are added once they stop changing).

errors.description: Files that couldn't be added, each with its latest problem (the first 10 by name); one stays until the file is added or goes away.

failed.description: How many files couldn't be added (they are tried again).

retryAt.description: When the next file that couldn't be added is tried again by itself.

targetLufs.description: Integrated loudness target (default from output.platform: -14 LUFS for social and YouTube, -16 generic).

normalize.description: Apply one static master gain so the estimated mix meets the target (default on for cuts with a voiceover; needs loudness evidence for the sources). QA measures the real render.

source.description: The clips' own audio (production sound) and dialogue tracks.

levelSpeech.description: Even out speech loudness between clips (on for new cuts; absent = off, as older cuts were made).

cutBlend.description: Seconds the sound blends at straight cuts so they never click (new cuts: 0.1; absent = none, as older cuts were made).

voices.description: Per person (by the name the speaker data shows) or per recording: a level change and a clearer voice over their speech.

enhanced.description: The processed copies (clearer voices) recordings play instead of their own sound; written by sound enhance.

said.description: Words changed in the speaker's own voice copy, with their consent: the new sound plays instead of the recording's own over each stretch. Written by cut say place.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the component's canonical source archive: the exact version a person approved.

libs.description: The shared libraries it imports (@metarush/lib/<name>) and their exact versions (SHA-256).

id.description: Target clip/overlay/audio/beat ID (or 'captions', 'voiceover', 'mix') for update/remove/move/lock ops; setTransition: the clip the transition leads into; splitClip/trimClip/slipClip/removeWords: the clip.

after.description: Insert or move after this clip ID (beat ID for addBeat/moveBeat).

before.description: Insert or move before this clip ID (beat ID for addBeat/moveBeat).

text.description: Value for setNotes/setTitle; removeWords: the words removed (kept for the record).

set.description: Fields to change for update ops.

voiceover.description: setScript: the whole voiceover (null removes it).

anchor.description: moveBeat: the beat's new anchor (or use after/before to reorder the script).

mix.description: setMix: the whole mix (null removes it).

transition.description: setTransition: how the clip (id) comes in, picture and sound (null = a plain cut). With edge end: how it fades out (type fade or dip-to-black, duration).

edge.description: setTransition: in (default) = the cut into the clip; end = the clip's fade-out (the end of the whole video when it is the last clip). trimClip: in = the clip's start, end = its end.

at.description: splitClip: the moment in the clip's footage (source seconds) where it is cut in two.

from.description: deleteRange: where the removed stretch starts (seconds on the cut's timeline); removeWords: where it starts in the clip's footage (source seconds).

to.description: deleteRange: where the removed stretch ends (timeline seconds); removeWords: where it ends in the footage; trimClip: the edge's new moment in the clip's footage (source seconds).

by.description: slipClip: seconds to slide the clip's footage (positive: later in the recording); the clip keeps its length and place.

newId.description: splitClip, deleteRange, removeWords: the name of the second part when a clip is cut in two (default: the clip's name with -2, -3…).

mode.description: trimClip: ripple (default: the rest of the cut moves up or back) or roll (the neighbouring clip's edge moves with it, so the cut keeps its length).

resource.description: setResource: the resource and exact version the short name (id) stands for (null removes it).

conversation.description: setConversation: the conversation and how this cut renders it, under the short name (id) its clips use (null removes it).

fixed.description: setFixed: the fixed copy the footage (id, an asset ID) plays in this cut (null: the original again).

framing.description: faces: crops keep the main face in frame (new cuts); follow: crops move with the subject as it moves; center or absent: crops keep the middle (older cuts). A clip's own focus or framing.auto wins.

template.description: A vetted template (the default). Leave it out for a project motion graphic (or for a role the layout pack fills).

motion.description: A project motion graphic (motion/<name> in the project folder) by name and approved version, instead of a template.

role.description: The part it plays in the layout pack: title-card, lower-third, end-screen, quote-card or chapter-card (a variant after a colon: lower-third:guest). Without a template the pack fills it.

at.description: When the graphic starts (seconds on the finished video; with a span: seconds after the span starts).

duration.description: How long it stays (seconds; at least 0.2). With a span: 0 = to the span's end.

notes.description: A person's notes about this graphic (kept with the cut; not shown in the video).

span.description: Last a section ({from, to}: clip names) or the whole video ({}); at and duration are then measured inside it.

changes.description: Moments in the footage from which the graphic's fields change while it stays on screen (a name bar's name follows who is on screen).

footage.description: The footage the moment is in (a clip's assetId).

at.description: Seconds in that footage from which the new fields apply.

params.description: The fields that change (merged over the graphic's own; a picture field can't change).

from.description: The clip the graphic starts with (default: the first).

to.description: The clip it ends with (default: the last).

peaks.description: Max absolute amplitude per bucket (0 to 1).

size.description: How large the inset is (default medium).

shape.description: rounded (default), square or circle (a round camera bubble).

frame.description: A line around the inset in one of the brand's colours (default none).

baseRevisionId.description: Revision this plan was written against. Required unless the project has no revisions yet.

rationale.description: Editorial reasoning for the whole change.

origin.description: Where the plan came from (set by MetaRush; e.g. assistant:<run>/<file> for a dashboard-assistant proposal). Recorded on the revision.

note.description: A few words saying what this version changes (flicker fixes and headline cards); shown on the version.

status.description: allowed, allowed_warning (getting close) or rejected (used up until it resets).

path.description: JSON pointer into the edit spec (for findings from validation).

text.description: An answer in the person's own words.

choices.description: Answers to pick from (none: a free-text question).

multiple.description: Several choices may be picked (tick boxes).

other.description: The person may also write an answer of their own.

why.description: Why Claude asks (shown under the question).

of.description: The footage or conversation it is from.

claude.description: The run waits for Claude to choose the moments.

run.description: The run, as people name it (run 4 of “App teaser”).

change.description: What the card keeps or changes, in plain words.

made.description: What it made: clips, a version, a render.

projectId.description: The project it is for (its footage goes there); without one

layout.description: How the first cut shows the screen and camera.

start.description: Where the file starts on the recording's clock (seconds).

drift.description: How much faster its clock runs (parts per million).

origin.description: Where the project came from, in a few words.

plan.description: Or: render the revision created by applying this plan file (same folder).

sha256.description: The exact version: the SHA-256 of its file. Updating to a newer version is an explicit change.

id.description: The change's record: who asked, whose voice copy and consent, and how it was checked.

from.description: Where in the recording the new sound starts (seconds; it begins and ends with the recording's own sound).

sound.description: The new sound (a clip MetaRush made, as long as the stretch).

picture.description: The stretch with the mouth matched to the new words (a clip MetaRush made, as long as the stretch).

versions.description: Changed files that became new versions.

missing.description: Files that went away (their resources stay, marked missing).

waiting.description: Large files kept on this machine until a cut uses them.

errors.description: Files this look couldn't add, each with why (they are tried again).

type.description: Collection name (such as jobs or edit_revisions or notifications) or a local event type (upload or assistant or settings).

at.description: Where it starts on the conversation's clock (seconds).

card.description: A text card (an off-camera interviewer's question).

in.description: Where in that footage it starts (seconds).

gap.description: The gap between the pictures (default thin).

frame.description: A line around each picture in one of the brand's colours (default none).

backdrop.description: What shows between the pictures: black (default) or the brand's background colour.

mode.description: cut: the sound changes with the picture; lead: this clip's sound starts early, before we see it (J-cut); carry: the previous clip's sound carries on over this clip (L-cut); auto: MetaRush moves the sound change into the nearest pause so no word is cut.

duration.description: lead/carry: seconds. auto: the most it may move the sound (default 1).

blend.description: Seconds over which one clip's sound fades out while the other's fades in (default: the mix's cutBlend, else 0.1).

notes.description: Editorial treatment summary shown to reviewers.

resources.description: Short name (lowercase letters, digits, - and _) → the resource and its exact version.

conversations.description: Short name → a conversation (several recordings of one talk, aligned) and how this cut renders it.

fixed.description: Footage (asset ID) → the fixed copy this cut plays instead of the original (steadier picture, cleaned-up voices…).

readBack.description: Also download every file from the new storage again and check it (slower; may cost downloads).

present.description: Already in the new storage (same size).

local.description: Of the files to copy, those already on this machine (not downloaded).

download.description: Bytes to download from the old storage.

differ.description: Keys the new storage already holds with another size (never overwritten; the move cannot finish until they are removed there).

machines.description: Other machines in this workspace: each switches with its own run of the move.

overrides.description: Environment variables that would override the new settings in config.yaml.

name.description: The storage in words (Google Cloud Storage bucket media).

locator.description: Where it is, without secrets (gs://bucket/prefix, s3://bucket/prefix@host, fs:/folder).

shared.description: Every machine in the workspace can reach it.

provider.description: filesystem (a folder: on this computer or a shared drive), s3 (S3-compatible online storage) or gcs (Google Cloud Storage).

root.description: filesystem: the folder that holds the media.

shared.description: filesystem: every machine of the workspace reaches the folder (a shared drive).

secretAccessKey.description: Sent once, never returned: kept in this computer's keychain.

secretVariable.description: The environment variable that holds the secret (installations that keep their secrets in the environment).

credentialsFile.description: gcs: a service-account key file on this computer (empty: this computer's Google sign-in).

speed.description: Playback rate (pitch preserved). Fitting may speed TTS up by at most 8%.

aiVoice.description: Generated by a synthetic voice (TTS or a voice clone); carried into delivery sidecars.

useProcessed.description: Play the processed (cleanup) version instead of the original (A/B).

input.description: New input tokens (not from the prompt cache).

cacheWrite.description: Tokens written to the prompt cache.

cacheRead.description: Tokens read from the prompt cache: every step reads the conversation again.

output.description: Tokens Claude wrote, its thinking included.

total.description: All of them: what the conversation's limit counts.

label.description: Readable one-line description (e.g. Read transcript · Interview A 0:11–0:18).

group.description: Consecutive steps with the same group show as one line.

many.description: The line for several steps of this group (%d is how many).

summary.description: Condensed input: the command or file or skill.

denied.description: The read-only allowlist refused this call.

output.description: Start of the tool's raw output (tool_result; raw view only).

outcome.description: Short outcome in plain words (e.g. looks good, 2 notes).

images.description: Images Claude looked at (served by GET /api/assistant/image).

todos.description: The checklist when Claude used TodoWrite.

proposal.description: The proposal file this call wrote (t<turn>/<name>).

type.description: cut; fade (in from the background); crossfade (dissolve); dip-to-black / dip-to-white (fade through black or white); wipe, slide, push, zoom, whip (see metarush edit transitions).

direction.description: wipe/slide/push/whip: the way the picture moves (left = the next shot comes in from the right). Default left.

easing.description: How the movement or blend is paced (default ease-in-out).

sent.description: The exact message sent to Claude Code: context preamble plus the prompt (raw view only).

userId.description: Who sent it: the person who typed it or answered, or for a note the person whose decision it reports (absent on older messages: the person who started the conversation).

steps.description: Claude Code's agentic steps in this turn.

denials.description: Tool calls the read-only allowlist refused.

resumed.description: Claude Code was restarted with --resume for this turn.

compact.description: MetaRush had Claude summarize the conversation, not something the person typed.

note.description: A dashboard update (an action's outcome) rather than something the person typed.

shown.description: What the person reads for this message (a note's plain line, an answer); the prompt is what Claude was sent.

subtype.description: Claude Code result subtype (success or error_max_budget_usd or error_max_turns or error_during_execution).

totalCostUsd.description: Spent in the conversation so far.

fingerprint.description: fp1 fingerprint the browser computed (first + last MiB); used to resume a re-dropped file.

rate.description: Bytes per second in the current stage (server-measured).

lastProgressAt.description: When bytes last moved (received or processed).

disconnected.description: The last chunk was cut off before it finished; cleared when sending resumes.

at.description: When the change is clearest (source seconds).

from.description: Where it starts (a cut: the same as at).

to.description: Where it ends (a cut: the same as at).

name.description: The person as the speaker data names them (Maya, Speaker 2).

assetId.description: Instead of a person: a whole recording (one person's own track).

gainDb.description: Level change over their speech in dB (0 = as recorded).

original.description: The script exactly as the person pasted or imported it (never changed afterwards; a new whole script replaces it).

active.description: Which version of the script the lines are (original by default).

parked.description: The lines of the script version not in use (not part of the cut).

speakingRateWpm.description: Words per minute for fit checks of beats without audio (default 155; a recording sets the measured rate).

fitPolicy.description: auto: recorded or imported audio extends the shot and TTS speeds up at most 8%; ask: warn and wait; shorten: rewrite the line. Warnings are always shown.

gap.description: Default pause (s) before a beat anchored after the previous one (default 0.3).

pending.description: Files waiting to stop changing before they are ingested.

ingesting.description: The file being ingested right now.

ingested.description: Files ingested since the watcher started.

op.description: same: in both; del: only in the person's line; add: only in Claude's.
